# Natively 2.9.1 — hidden screenshots and Phone Mirror

On macOS, Command+B can hide the overlay while Command+H and Command+Shift+Enter capture the screen without reopening it. Command+Shift+Enter also starts the answer while hidden.

When a phone is connected, Natively sends the original PNG screenshot before the answer. The phone receives streamed answer text and follows new content to the bottom, including after the image finishes loading.

Install the DMG matching your Mac's processor. This release is built from the fork's `codex/phone-mirror-stealth-mode` branch and includes the private premium module through the release workflow.
